title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Core Indicators: Moving Averages, RSI, and Volume

questions.text: Which set of indicator readings would suggest a confirmed uptrend?
options: Price below its moving average, RSI very low, trading volume low
Price above its moving average, RSI in the middle range, trading volume high
Price above its moving average, RSI very high, trading volume low
Price below its moving average, RSI in the middle range, trading volume high
questions.explanation: An uptrend is confirmed when price is above the moving average, RSI shows moderate momentum, and volume is strong.

questions.text: True or false: A price increase on low volume indicates strong institutional backing.
questions.explanation: Low volume on a price rise lacks the conviction needed to signal strong institutional support.
